name: hud_ui_mgr_set_mode_counter_state
description: HudUiMgr::SetModeCounterState updates the active mode counter index when arming a counter and selects the image for the requested counter state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the VC5SP3 manifest exists but this acceptance is functional through native mode-counter tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40f1a0 validates the state-2 path restoring the previous active counter to stateImages[1], updating activeModeCounterIdx, and selecting stateImages[newState] for the requested counter.

The native counter smoke verifies state 2 changes the active counter, restores the previous armed image, selects the active image for the new counter, and state 0 selects the idle image without changing the active counter index.
